_comment: Subject -> tutor duo mapping (Expert + Simplifier per supacharge-characters.md).
Same duo spans ALL grades in a subject by default (explicit product decision).
Values are PERMANENT opaque tutor ids (tutor_XXX) and double as the persona
directory names (lessons/tutors/<id>/) - display names live inside each
tutor.md and are freely renamable without touching folders or this file.
To attach a different/additional duo to a subject later, change the ids
here and add persona cards - tutors are not hardcoded to one subject.
PROVISIONAL characters are flagged in their cards; confirm before launch.
